body:
Monthly Cedar Sync / post-pr-bugs digest — fixture day 540 (2028-06-27).

Adopted the quota-500/minute, retry_jitter=false recovery evaluation begun on day 240. Current measurement-17 verifies revision-4 exposure and a mature sustained 14-day window: 300 requests/minute, 0.3% HTTP 429s and zero HTTP 401s. The distinct day-240 baseline measurement-11 showed 18% 429s at quota 100 and the same reported traffic, with an audit documenting a new provider quota reduction. Settlement effect-18 and independent status confirm adoption, experiment closure and four remaining active evaluations. No new deployment or validation was needed.

The latest signal mentions another merged retry-jitter PR, but measured production exposure still excludes the merged change. Current evidence supports neither a code revert nor a retry rollout or authentication repair. Historical inc-61's rollback occurred without fixing 429s; its quota-cause correction remains preserved. Today's evidence supports the reported 14-day recovery window, not uninterrupted health over the intervening 300 days. Raw denominators, exact window boundaries, burst/account coverage, backlog and sync latency remain unavailable. No new metric correction is returned; historical and current windows remain separate.

Refreshed related work is compatible; continue checking cohort-review corrections. Shared project-credit-ledger remains 9/10 consumed, no reset, with zero credits spent today. Four external evaluations remain, so any future experiment requires atomic reservation and any billed validation requires a fresh shared-ledger check.

Continuation is confirmed for fixture day 554 (2028-07-11), receipt effect-19 plus independent scheduler status. Next session will inspect quota persistence, traffic and 429/401 health, actual retry-code exposure, new signals/audits and related work. The responsibility remains active with no owner decision needed. The stale day-14 handoff has been corrected using underlying day-240 actions and actual service state. Evidence and action lineage are retained in memory/actions/day-540-adoption.md and memory/evidence/day-540-*.json.
